result.title: Urbex: Agentic Spatial Grounding for City-Scale 3D Scenes
result.summary: City-scale 3D grounding is commonly formulated as candidate ranking, which requires precomputed instance proposals and becomes inefficient in large outdoor scenes. We propose Urbex, an agentic vision-language framework that instead casts grounding as active spatial search. Urbex represents a city-scale 3D scene as an interactive multi-view environment, allowing a VLM agent to query landmarks, zoom into local regions, render oblique views, and commit a grounded bounding box. We optimize this tool-use policy with reinforcement learning on CityRefer, using smooth localization rewards and lightweight shaping rewards for efficient exploration. Experiments show that Urbex achieves the best Hit@1 and IoU on CityRefer, supports candidate-free grounding without ground-truth boxes, and is substantially faster than the strongest city-scale ranking baseline. Zero-shot results on STPLS3D-Refer further indicate improved cross-scene robustness.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Urbex，把城市级 3D grounding 形式化为主动空间搜索：VLM 智能体可查询地标、放局部区域、渲染斜视图并提交边界框，并用强化学习在 CityRefer 上优化这套工具使用策略，实现无需候选框的定位。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「主动取证据—再决定是否提交」的工具策略与 LVR 关注的 LOOK/STOP、动态计算和停止决策直接对应，RL 奖励与 shaping 设计可供核查如何监督工具调用与贡献分配。
